description: Sends an instruction to a call that is IN PROGRESS — it changes the live conversation immediately. type: 'note' = guidance for the assistant (not spoken); 'ask' = the assistant asks the caller this at the next pause; 'say' = the assistant says this text (max 300 chars); 'end' = the assistant says goodbye and hangs up (cannot be undone); 'transfer' = transfers the caller to one of the assistant's configured transfer targets, by name (free phone numbers are not accepted). Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks; do not invent text. Check call2me_get_live_transcript for the instruction_applied event.

call_id.description: The call id of the call in progress.

transfer_to.description: For transfer: the NAME of one of the assistant's transfer targets.

name: call2me_instruct_call
title: Instruct a live call
